plugin.name: IntelEngine
plugin.description:
AI-powered NPC autonomy mod for Skyrim, powered by SkyrimNet. Player FAQ: IntelEngineTools\FAQ.md
Features: - Player-directed NPC tasks (GoToLocation, FetchPerson, DeliverMessage, SearchForActor, ScheduleMeeting, EscortTarget) - LLM Dungeon Master story events (seek_player, informant, road_encounter, ambush, stalker, message, quest) - Autonomous NPC social interactions (npc_interaction, npc_gossip) - All features configurable via MCM
Requirements: - SKSE - SkyrimNet Beta 25 minimum (tested with official Beta 28) - PapyrusExtender (po3) - PapyrusUtil - SkyUI (MCM) - Papyrus MessageBox - SKSE NG (Skyrim 1.6 and earlier) OR PapyrusMessageBox-1.7.104 (Skyrim 1.7) (only needed without Magelight UI: with Magelight, choice prompts use its page)
Optional dashboard host (install separately; runtimes not bundled): - Magelight UI 1.7.1 or newer, recommended - PrismaUI, frozen fallback Both dashboard asset trees are included; neither host is required for gameplay. Set ui.host: auto|magelight|prismaui in IntelEngine settings.yaml; restart Skyrim to change hosts. Magelight adds Escape close; PrismaUI retains existing behavior. Director submission does not close or notify. With Magelight, IE's choice prompts (Allow/Deny, door knock, quest offer) use a Magelight page; without it, the Papyrus MessageBox.

plugin.name: Legacy save converter
plugin.description: Starting a fresh game? You don't need the converter. Upgrading a save from IntelEngine 3.5.2 or earlier: 1. Close Skyrim and back up the save's .ess and .skse. 2. Drag the .ess onto Convert-IE-Save.bat in "IntelEngineTools" (MO2: right-click IntelEngine → Open in Explorer). 3. Start Skyrim and load the new "..._IEconverted" save. See FAQ.md in IntelEngineTools for more.
